culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Controlled Affiliated investments ... Fair Value at March 31, 2026 $246,700,365
Total Non-Controlled Affiliated Investments ... Fair Value at March 31, 2026 $109,219,052

findings.detail: Controlled and non-controlled affiliated rollforward totals totaling $355,919,417 were added to the underlying debt and equity positions, inflating extracted FV from $657,323,982 to $1,013,243,399.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation proves a double count. The filing schedule reports total debt and equity investments of $657,323,982, whereas extracted holdings FV is $1,013,243,399. The $355,919,417 excess exactly equals the controlled-affiliated total of $246,700,365 plus the non-controlled-affiliated total of $109,219,052. These rollforward aggregate rows were therefore counted in addition to their underlying positions; the F25 growth divergence is a real extraction defect.
